previous_statement: Every T in calU satisfies ||T||<=4/3 under the selected smallness guard.
new_statement: The guard in 1.1 gives epsilon_r<=1/16. For T in calU, def-approximate-unitary-space gives T^dagger bold-dot T=J, while the exact-unit clause of def-epsilon-cstar-algebra gives ||J||=1. Its C*-inequality yields (1-epsilon_r)||T||^2<=||T^dagger bold-dot T||=1. Hence ||T||<=sqrt(16/15)<4/3 (because 16/15<16/9). This also bounds ||T^dagger||=||T||.
